# AIPUSH

> Free AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) analyzer — score how ready a website is for AI agents and answer engines.

## About

AIPUSH is a free analyzer at https://aipush.app. Enter a website URL and AIPUSH scans it for AI-agent and answer-engine readiness, then returns a 0-100 score, an AEO Level (1-5), five category gauges, and copy-ready fixes you can paste into an AI coding agent (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot). The first fixes are free; the rest unlock after a free email confirmation.

It checks five categories: Agent Discovery, Agent Interfaces, Identity & Auth, Content Structure, and Structured Data — covering signals such as robots.txt, sitemaps, llms.txt, `/.well-known/*` resources, structured data, and machine-readable content.

- [Agent skills catalog](https://aipush.app/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
